_comment: The enforcement layer. All checks route through framework/scripts/ so hooks, CI and agents agree on what 'green' means. Define this project's commands in framework/scripts/gate.config.sh (see gate.config.example.sh); until then the scripts no-op and nothing blocks. PreToolUse: while a wave is in flight (wave.sh start), all-inclusive git add/commit -a is refused so one task's commit cannot sweep other lanes' work.
